description_en: Retrieves basic information about a specified image, such as the file name, format, size, and resolution
description_zh: 获取指定图片的文件名、格式、大小和分辨率等基本信息
name: DetectImageBasicInfo

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. Only HTTP and HTTPS protocols are supported. Specify either ImageUrl or ObjectKey. At least one of them is required
parameters.help_zh: 图片的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The ObjectKey of the image in OSS. When using ObjectKey, ensure that the key belongs to the namespace of the current caller. Specify either ImageUrl or ObjectKey. At least one of them is required
parameters.help_zh: 图片在 OSS 中的 `ObjectKey`。使用 `ObjectKey` 时需确保该 Key 属于当前调用者的命名空间。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: object_key

Code.description_en: The business error code. "OK" is returned if the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 "OK"

Dpi.description_en: The image resolution (width × height), such as 1920 × 1080. This value is empty if the resolution cannot be identified
Dpi.description_zh: 图片分辨率（宽 * 高），如 1920 * 1080。无法识别时为空

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. 200 is returned if the request was successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 200

Message.description_en: The additional information. "success" is returned if the request was successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 "success"

Size.description_en: The file size in a human-readable format, such as 1.5 MB or 256 KB
Size.description_zh: 文件大小（人类可读格式），如 1.5 MB、256 KB

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

Type.description_en: The image format, such as JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WEBP. UNKNOWN is returned if the format cannot be identified
Type.description_zh: 图片格式，如 JPEG、PNG、GIF、WEBP 等。无法识别时返回 `UNKNOWN`
